style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EAlong with these, I’ve attended UG Practical exam duties\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EICU \u0026amp; AMC DUTIES\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EICU \u0026amp; AMC DUTIES lasted for 5 days, during which I had 12 hour shifts and I’ve learnt the following:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E1.) Right way to draw an ABG SAMPLE from radial and femoral artery sites\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E2.) To put a RYLE’s tube in an intubated patient and a patient without intubation\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E3.) I’ve seen patient crashing and being intubated and performed CPR (Cardiopulmonary resuscitation)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E4.) I’ve inserted a foley’s catheter to a male patient which I never did before\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E5.) Monitoring patient’s vitals hourly in both ICU \u0026amp; AMC\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E6.) I also saw how a HEMODIALYSIS CATHETER is inserted for a patient who needed dialysis.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003ENEPHROLOGY DUTIES\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003ENEPHROLOGY DUTIES lasted for 5 days during which I’ve seen:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E1.) how the dialysis machine is connected to the AV fistula of the patients and its working\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E2.) The presenting symptoms of the patient when they need dialysis immediately like SOB due to Flash pulmonary edema, severe Hypertension\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E3.) How to manage the above situations\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E4.) Monitoring all the patient’s vitals before and after dialysis\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E5.) \u0026nbsp;Complications which can occur during dialysis\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EWARD DUTIES\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EWARD DUTIES lasted for 5 days during which I got to see many cases of different units\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EI’ve attended rounds and listened to discussions of the cases by Pgs and Hod sir and learnt many take home points\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EI’ve taken histories of all the patients present in the ward for the day and presented them to the PG who was allotted ward duties since day 1. That helped me know the case details before rounds so that i can participate in the rounds actively.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EI’ve helped BDS students to take basic histories of patients.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EI’ve updated fever charts of the patients in the ward\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EI’ve done dressing to a patient who had a foot ulcer but was in medical ward for fever charting\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EI’ve asked my co interns to update blogs and respective Pajr groups of the patients\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EPSYCHIATRY POSTINGS\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EPSYCHIATRY postings lasted for the last 15 days during which I saw many interesting cases like\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EDELUSIONAL PARASITOSIS\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EPOST TRAUMATIC STRESS DISORDER\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EDEPRESSION\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003ESCHIZOPHRENIA\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EALCOHOL DEPENDENCE \u0026nbsp;SYNDROME\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EI’ve also visited DEADDICTION ward where patients participated in regular daily activities like PRAYER, TELEVISION, GAMES\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EThe approach to a case in psychiatry was fascinating\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EI also learned about mental status examination\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003EI attended UG lectures along with my co intern and PG\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\u003Cbr color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EC\/o Difficulty in Breathing Since Morning\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EC\/o Decreased Urine Output Since Morning(Once Since Morning)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EC\/o Decreased Food Intake Since Morning\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EHOPI:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic till 2011 then she had developed pain in both fingers of the upper limbs \u0026amp; damage \u0026amp; peeling of nails of fingers of upper limb then had developed pain wrist \u0026amp; elbow joint \u0026amp; knee pains.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EPt went to hospital \u0026amp;
